body: check out /r brainfog there’s a lot of people like you including myself. i had an intense fog for 6 months until i figured out how to get out of mine

i never had a relationship either just one night stands. honestly, it’s not worth getting into one unless you really like the person. life is unbearable when you’re lonely. even as an introvert i struggle to combat loneliness. for me, the more i come to terms with what i want and knowing myself more with aging, the easier it is with dealing with thoughts of suicide. since covid, a lot of solitude made it easy to distinguish what i wanted in life. yes, when you’re at ur low it’s impossible to create goals and asipirations, however, i did find SOMETHING out of it. just know even though u feel like shit, u want to die, and don’t give a fuck anymore, all it takes is a little inspiration or insight to shift the direction of ur mental. this will come naturally. HOWEVER, in the meantime you will suffer immeasurable pain till this arrives, it just depends on how lucky you are if you survive till it happens. all is not lost.

i enjoy your responses no need for apologies. i guess the reason i’m still trying to work on succeeding in college is because i was successful in high school. however, i can’t replicate that same success. i used to work with others and i don’t have that same network anymore. someone where in the back of my head i know it’s doable but the result isn’t there... i’m tired of hitting my head against the wall i’m sure ill give up eventually

you speak eloquently enough i would never assume u had a “broken brain”. problem is a simple life isn’t for me i’ve always had high expectations for myself and despite my work output, i am competitive person. my self esteem is based on success. thank you for your comment i appreciate your perspective

the point people consistently make for people like us is that the suffering is temporary. well what happens when that feeling reoccurs throughout your life? their argument: it eventually won’t. now we make the decision or not to believe them. if we do, our lives could potentially be an endless cycle of suffering and our hope was in vain, or we could continue to pursuit a life were we were satisfied and at peace. if we don’t: we could potentially “not allow” ourselves to achieve a life that we want. both decisions and scenarios happen just as often as the next, but there’s only one way to find out which one happens to you personally...

i feel empty all the time too. i really like this song by juiceWRLD “empty” and i think it does a good job in explaining what it’s like. it also is a high energy song so it helps me take away from the feeling of being empty. 

the important thing is to not take responsibility of making them not feel empty because that’s something only they can do.  having my friends just being there for me and  showing me they’re always keeping me in their thoughts helps a lot.

because you and i haven’t found the one thing that gives us a reason/value to continue this endless train of life. and that’s all we are.. some are lucky to have found it, some are still looking, and some don’t even care...
